# Trendy Hair Salon

## About
Trendy Hair Salon is an easy-to-reach neighborhood salon in Agios Athanasios, with straightforward parking and a small, well-reviewed stylist team. Trendy Hair Salon is a hair salon in Agios Athanasios, Limassol, Cyprus.

## Services
Sample categories only — replace with Trendy Hair Salon's actual current menu and
pricing before this file is published anywhere real:
- Haircuts: Precision cuts for men and women, done by a stylist team clients ask for by name.
- Color & Highlights: Full color and highlight services using professional-grade products.
- Blowouts & Styling: Finishing styles for everyday wear or a night out.
- Beard & Grooming: Beard shaping and grooming to round out a full service visit.
